title: Toy Safety Regulation (EU) 2025/2509

productGroups.notes: retentionYears is sourced: the Regulation requires 10 years after placing on the market, including in cases of insolvency. Adopted 2025-12-12 and in force since 2026-01-01, but fully applicable only from 2030-08-01 after a 54-month transition, so nothing is bindingly determinable yet. The implementing acts defining the technical and procedural passport requirements are not published, so a conformant toy data carrier cannot be generated today.

notes: A direct instrument with a firm passport date, which is rarer than it looks — most of the catalog is undated. Its identifier-sharing provision is one of the two proofs that a product bears one passport however many instruments apply: the unique product identifier, operator identifier and registration identifier 'shall be the same' as those used under other Union law.
